remarks: Welcome home to 216 Main Street in the heart of New Canaan. This in town Victorian has been exquisitely restored and is just steps from train station, library, shops and restaurants. Built in 1898, it has been designated by the NC Historical Society as an historic property. Relax on the beautiful front porch or enter through the antique door to an oversized foyer leading to the L shaped living room. There is a dining area and combination kitchen family room straight ahead. A lovely bedroom and full bath on the main level are perfect for an au pair or guests. Take the stairs past the antique leaded window to the second level with a large sitting/office area. The primary suite is over sized with a walk in closet and beautifully updated bath. Another bedroom is a suite of contiguous spaces featuring a Victorian "turret" room. Flooded with natural light, there is plenty of space for family to spread out in private quarters. The fourth bedroom is filled with light and has a reading nook. Just behind the home is a four room, fully renovated cottage/studio with huge living room, antique floors loft space and high ceilings. This home is impeccable,newly painted,has a new driveway,new landscaping and more. 1140 square feet of space in the detached studio.
